concept.setting: a white-stone human city by the sea under a bright blue sky
concept.buildings: thick white stone walls, deep blue-grey slate roofs swept steep and oversized, chunky timber-and-plaster upper storeys in the outer streets, round towers with tall conical blue roofs, heavy arched gateways, gold trim
concept.landmark: a great white cathedral with blue spires and a gold-domed bell tower, lion statues at its steps
concept.street_life: blue and gold lion banners on every tower, canal bridges, market stalls with striped awnings, guards' posts, lamp posts, flower planters
concept.greenery: tall elms along the avenues, a park with a fountain, climbing roses on white walls
concept.materials: stone bricks, smooth quartz, polished diorite, deepslate tile roofs, oak and spruce timber, blue and yellow wool
